title: Threat / Vulnerability / Risk Analysis
description: Meridian Hospital's security team has handed you their asset inventory, threat intelligence, and vulnerability scan results. Apply the Risk = Likelihood × Impact formula to identify the most critical risk, then decode the hidden flag.
hint: Risk = Likelihood × Impact. Use cat and grep to read files. Use Bash arithmetic: echo $((4 * 5)) to compute risk scores. Check risk_guide.txt for scoring details. The flag is base64-encoded.
starterCode:
#!/bin/bash
# ============================================
# SENTINEL SECURITY LAB: TVR Analysis
# Meridian General Hospital — Risk Assessment
# ============================================
# Available files:
#   asset_inventory.txt   - Hospital assets and values
#   threat_intel.txt      - CISA threat intelligence
#   vulnerability_scan.txt - CVE scan results
#   risk_guide.txt        - Risk scoring formula
#   hidden_flag.b64       - Encoded flag (find it!)
#
# Use grep, cat, and Bash math ($((a * b)))
# to classify threats and compute risk scores.
# ============================================
echo "=== TVR ANALYSIS STARTED ==="
ls

additionalFiles.name: asset_inventory.txt

additionalFiles.name: risk_guide.txt
additionalFiles.content:
=== RISK ASSESSMENT GUIDE ===
Framework: NIST SP 800-30 (simplified)

Formula:
  RISK_SCORE = Likelihood_Score x Impact_Score

Scoring Scale (1-5):
  5 = Critical
  4 = High
  3 = Medium
  2 = Low
  1 = Very Low

Example calculation -- Ransomware targeting Patient Database:
  Likelihood_Score = 4  (RANSOMWARE is HIGH likelihood)
  Impact_Score     = 5  (Patient Database is CRITICAL value)
  RISK_SCORE       = 4 x 5 = 20

Bash arithmetic:
  echo "RISK_SCORE: $((4 * 5))"

Risk thresholds:
  20-25 : CRITICAL  -- immediate remediation required
  15-19 : HIGH      -- remediate within 30 days
  10-14 : MEDIUM    -- remediate within 90 days
  1-9   : LOW       -- monitor and review annually

tasks.title: Survey available intelligence files
tasks.desc: Run ls to list all files in the analysis environment.

tasks.title: Identify HIGH-likelihood threats
tasks.desc: Run cat threat_intel.txt | grep "HIGH" to find the most likely threats.

tasks.title: Find known CVE vulnerabilities
tasks.desc: Run cat vulnerability_scan.txt | grep "CVE" to list all CVE findings.

tasks.title: Calculate the top risk score
tasks.desc: Apply Risk = Likelihood × Impact for RANSOMWARE vs Patient Database. Run: echo "RISK_SCORE: $((4 * 5))"

tasks.title: Flag the critical asset
tasks.desc: Identify the highest-risk asset and run: echo "CRITICAL: Patient Database"

tasks.title: Decode the hidden flag
tasks.desc: Run base64 -d hidden_flag.b64 to decode and reveal the lab flag.
